name: Adam Bin M Raman

bio: Innovation strategist and former Founder with 10+ years of experience bridging the gap between physical infrastructure and digital solutions. Successfully bootstrapped a design-build firm to profitability (100% YoY growth) before pivoting to a Research Sabbatical in Climate Tech. Expert in Human-Centric Design, applying deep user empathy to make complex technical systems (Spaces, Energy, Software) intuitive for humans. Currently leveraging AI-assisted workflows to drive digital transformation and sustainable innovation.

highlights: Conducting comprehensive energy audits and designing M&E system proposals for new builds.
Developed internal automation tools and custom apps to parse Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS).
Streamlined regulatory compliance ensuring consistent deliverables across complex projects.
